title: Labcorp Q2 2026 results-date Form 8-K
excerpt: Labcorp stated that it would release Q2 2026 results before the market opened on July 30, 2026 and hold its call at 9:00 a.m. ET.
summary: The SEC filing establishes that decisive Q2 evidence was unavailable at the July 28 alert cutoff, making the overbought move pre-results timing evidence rather than confirmation of a reported operating change.
